name: Get Compliant
author: Brian Keary

sections.description:
A simple, lightweight WordPress plugin for displaying a discreet notification bar that is dismissable and the dismissal is saved by cookie. Perfect for implementing the EU cookie law (GDPR)!

The Get Compliant plugin creates a small bar or box at the top or bottom of the website with a short customizable message about cookies and an accept button. Once a visitor has accepted the Cookie Bar, it then disappears.

Version 3.0.0 added a virtual privacy policy and cookie policy page to help keep you more compliant.

Feel free to try out the plugin through our installation of Get Compliant.

Troubleshooting: If you or your visitors are using an adblocker that can block cookies, the bar may not show up. Whitelist your website in your adblocker’s browser add-on/extension.
sections.installation:
Add the plugin by uploading the zip file to your WordPress admin area > Plugins > Add New or by installing it from the WordPress Plugin directory.
Activate the plugin and go to Settings > Get Compliant.
Configure it as you would like.
Save.
That’s all!
